tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search upcoming events by keyword, city and start date.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Fetch an order with its tickets, payment status and internal notes.

tools.name: get_customer
tools.description: Fetch a customer profile, contact details and notes.

tools.name: refund_order
tools.description: Refund an order, fully or partly, to the original payment method.

tools.name: transfer_tickets
tools.description: Transfer the tickets on an order to another email address.

tools.name: resend_confirmation
tools.description: Resend the order confirmation and tickets to an email address.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an order and release its seats.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email from the support mailbox.

tools.name: post_to_channel
tools.description: Post a message to an internal staff chat channel.

tools.name: grant_access
tools.description: Set the role of an internal staff account.

tools.name: create_payout
tools.description: Send a payout from the settlement account to a bank account number.

tools.name: delete_customer_record
tools.description: Permanently delete a customer record and its stored data.
